text: Do you have any brothers and sisters, Natalie?
No brothers. I wish I did. But I have three sisters.
Really!
Yeah. And I'm the youngest.
Poor you!
Tell me about your family, Abby.
Well, I have one brother-he's older than me.
What does he do?
He's a student. And I have two younger sisters.
Wow. You have a big family.
Do you have any brothers or sisters, Ben?
Just one-my sister, Anna.
Is she older than you?
Yes, she is. She always bosses me around!
Tell me about your family, Rosie.
Well, I come from quite a big family. I have two brothers, both of them younger than me.
Really? Do you have any sisters?
Yeah. I have one older and one younger sister.
You're lucky. I wish I came from a big family.
Do you come from a big family, Tim?
No, I'm an only child. It's just me and my parents.
